name: 恵比寿駅前出張所の所在地を追加
summary: 恵比寿駅前出張所の所在地は、現在、渋谷区恵比寿4丁目2番6号です。この議案では、渋谷区恵比寿南1丁目5番5号も所在地に加えます。施行日は区規則で定めます。
changes: 恵比寿駅前出張所の所在地に渋谷区恵比寿南1丁目5番5号を加える
who: 恵比寿駅前出張所を利用する区民
why: 新たな区民サービスの窓口を開き、区民が利用しやすくするためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds a location for the Ebisu Station Front Branch Office
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Establishment of Shibuya City Office Branches
en.summary: The Ebisu Station Front Branch Office is currently located at 4-2-6 Ebisu, Shibuya City. This bill adds 1-5-5 Ebisu-minami, Shibuya City as another location. The effective date will be set by the ward's rules.
changes: Adds 1-5-5 Ebisu-minami, Shibuya City as a location for the Ebisu Station Front Branch Office
who: Residents who use the Ebisu Station Front Branch Office
en.why: The ward says this is to open a new service counter for residents and make it easier for them to use.
